2. If someone is furry then they are young. (Rule 1) → Erin is young.  
3. All furry people are big. (Rule 3) → Erin is big.  
4. Erin is furry and young (from 1 and 2). Furry, young people are round. (Rule 6) → Erin is round.  
5. Erin is big and round (from 3 and 4). Big, round people are not white. (Rule 5) → Erin is not white.  

Since we have derived that Erin is not white, the statement “Erin is white” does not follow.

ANSWER: False
